en: The Warden of Ansedra's water, who keeps the lagoon flat and the barges poled. He read the declaration in a clear voice and believed every word of it. The flat-engine on his barge stills the water in its wake.
Take your places in the gallery. The vows are at dusk.
To the barge. Get through the water-gate.
A hull-captain needs someone who may go up to the dais.
Merel cuts one line each turn; four free the barge. Kerrid's Hold the Steps takes a Stillguard's grip meant for her.
Each flat-engine pulse Slows the whole party for a turn. Only Liss can break it, with Strip the Drum.
Order shrines have gone dark: they neither heal nor save. Kirru and Saltwright shrines still do.
A flake of the Lacquer Court's red, broken off in the fighting. Used in Customize.
A wright's lamp with a crack across the glass, carried in a padded box. Liss won't let anyone else hold the box.
Wrist-guards lacquered the court's red. She wore them to the wedding.
